location.description: Used to find the parent data policy. If omitted, it can be parsed from the parent resource identifier.
location.rationale: Location identifies the parent data policy.

data_policy_id.description: ID of the parent data policy.

project.description: Project ID for the parent data policy.

member/members.description: Identities granted the IAM role on the data policy.
member/members.rationale: Members control who receives access through the IAM binding or member resource.
member/members.compliant: Set member or members to specific users, groups, or service accounts.
member/members.non-compliant: Include public principals such as `allUsers` or `allAuthenticatedUsers`.

role.description: IAM role granted on the data policy.
role.rationale: Role determines the level of access granted on the protected data.
role.compliant: Use a role such as `roles/bigquerydatapolicy.maskedReader` or `roles/bigquerydatapolicy.viewer` as needed.

policy_data.description: IAM policy document used by the policy resource.
